meta.title: Safety guide | LearningLinks
meta.description: Checklists for schools, families and educators. LearningLinks does not run background checks.

title: Safety guide
intro: LearningLinks is only a connection website. These checklists help you stay safe, but they do not replace your own checks or the law.

hirers.title: Before you hire or book
hirers.h1: Confirm who they are. Ask for ID and check it matches the profile.
hirers.h2: Ask for a police record certificate yourself. We never see it.
hirers.h3: Check that they have the right to work and to tutor. Some work permits do not allow private lessons.
hirers.h4: Check references and try a short trial class.
hirers.h5: For children, start in a public place, or online with a parent present.

educators.title: Before you accept an offer
educators.e1: Check that the school or family is real. Ask for a registered name, address and tax ID.
educators.e2: Never pay to apply or to be hired. LearningLinks never charges educators.
educators.e3: Do not share ID numbers or documents until you have agreed to work together.
educators.e4: Check that your work permit allows the work you are offered.
educators.e5: Get the terms in writing: pay, hours and contract length.

say: A few things are worth doing before you hire, book or accept. I'll keep it short.
